row:
Scottsdale Cat Clinic is a full-service veterinary hospital for cats only. We exist to increase the love between cats and their owners. There is joy, satisfaction, warmth and care in having a cat in the house.  Scottsdale Cat Clinic is here to make sure your cat stays happy and healthy for its whole life.

We've created these videos to help you better understand your cat's body, your cat's temperament and some of the illnesses that can befall your cat. We encourage you to contact us or another trusted veterinarian if you have any concerns about the health of your pet.

Life, liberty and the pursuit of cat videos. That’s what makes the internet great!
